caption: A block of 96 spearmen, 6 files of 16, doubles its frontage to 12 files of 8 (explicatio, B). Each man follows a man he can see. The front rank stays on the line it stood on, within 0.002 m, while its files open out sideways. The rear half of each file steps sideways into the interval on its right and comes up it in column behind its half-file leader, so no man walks through a man of his own file, and the closest two men stay 0.37 m apart. Before, the block re-centred, so its front walked back 3.08 m, and each file sent its rear half forward through its front half: 44 men set off on routes crossing those of their own file, and two men came within 0.223 m of each other, under the 0.225 m floor the demo defect scan judges a reshape by.
